verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API (endpoints at api.beglaubigt.de/v1), webhooks with HMAC signature verification, and an llms.txt file, but nothing mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. A raw HTTP API is a developer building block, not an official SDK, so the story is unevidenced; the OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
